# Code Chaos

> Code Chaos is a Hitech Psytrance, Psycore and Darkpsy producer from Hamburg, Germany, and the studio project of Tim Borchert, active since 2016 with 24+ releases. The site offers three things: audio plugins by **Code Chaos Audio** (sold on Gumroad, free demos), genre-specific mastering for psytrance, hitech and psycore as **Code Chaos Mastering**, and Code Chaos' own music (releases and genre guides). Today Code Chaos is a studio project only, without bookings.

Primary site language: German (de). English versions: home, mastering, genre guides, release pages and the Crucible plugin page (all other plugin pages are German). Plugins are sold and downloaded on Gumroad (timberwolf688.gumroad.com); every paid plugin has a free demo (full plugin, short noise burst every 45 s). No AU format (Logic Pro not supported); macOS builds are Apple Silicon (arm64) only and not signed or notarized. Metal and gothic mastering is a separate studio by Tim Borchert: Polished Media, https://polished.media
Last updated: 2026-11-11

## Plugins (Code Chaos Audio)

- [All plugins (German)](https://codechaos-official.de/plugins/): overview of all plugins with price, formats and systems, free demos
- [Crucible](https://codechaos-official.de/plugins/crucible/): 3-band harmonic saturation, 5 saturation types per band (Hard Clip, Wavefolder, Tube, Diode, Tape), per-band Drive, Mix, Gain, Mute, Solo, oversampling up to 8x; version 1.1.0; €19, free demo; VST3 + standalone, Windows 10+ only. English page: [Crucible (English)](https://codechaos-official.de/en/plugins/crucible/). License key from the Gumroad receipt activates up to 3 computers, works offline for up to 60 days.
- [Kick+Bass Engine](https://codechaos-official.de/plugins/psy-kick-bass/): kick and rolling bass in one instrument for psytrance, hitech and psycore at 140–300+ BPM; kick tuned to the bass note and ended before the first bass note (0 ms kick energy after the bass start in our measurements at 145–250 BPM), 8 rolling patterns, 4 bass modes, kick designer, built-in scope, mono below 150 Hz, 14 factory presets; €24, free demo; VST3 + standalone, Windows 10/11 and macOS (Apple Silicon)
- [Shardstep](https://codechaos-official.de/plugins/shardstep/): tempo-synced stutter, glitch and tape stop effect for hitech and psycore at 200–300 BPM; 16-step pattern (repeats 1/8 to 1/64 incl. triplets, reverse, tape stop, gate, crush), MIDI trigger, slice fades 0.5–8 ms, zero latency, 15 factory patterns; €15, free demo; VST3 + standalone, Windows 10/11 and macOS (Apple Silicon)
- [Chaos FM](https://codechaos-official.de/plugins/chaos-fm/): 3-operator FM synth (VST3) for hitech, psycore and darkpsy; 3 algorithms, filter with drive, up to 4-voice unison, mono/legato with glide, GENERATE button (Lead, Bass, Acid, Stab, Pluck, FX), 12 factory presets; €19, free demo; VST3 + standalone, Windows 10/11 only
- [Kick/Bass Scope](https://codechaos-official.de/plugins/kick-bass-scope/): free (pay what you want) beat-synced oscilloscope that shows kick and bass on top of each other to check kick/bass phase: peaks in dBFS, clip line, sum curve, kick/bass correlation with a warning when they are out of phase, overlap time in ms, 13 presets; analyzer only, it does not shift or align anything, audio passes through bit-identical; VST3 + standalone, Windows 10/11 and macOS (Apple Silicon)
- [Gravesaw](https://codechaos-official.de/plugins/gravesaw/): black metal amp sim with built-in cab for guitar and bass DI (Black Metal Suite); noise gate, tight, 4x oversampled gain (raw/thick), tone stack with Fizz and Presence, 19 synthesised cabs or cab off, 16 presets, latency 61 samples; €19, free demo; VST3 + standalone, Windows 10/11 and macOS (Apple Silicon)
- [Rimehall](https://codechaos-official.de/plugins/rimehall/): cold reverb, octave shimmer and tape/lo-fi atmosphere bus with ducking (Black Metal Suite); decay 0.3–30 s, Frost tone control, wow/flutter/saturation/hiss, 14 presets, constant 4 ms latency; €19, free demo; VST3 + standalone, Windows 10/11 and macOS (Apple Silicon)
- [Frostfret](https://codechaos-official.de/plugins/frostfret/): physically modelled guitar instrument played from MIDI, no samples (Black Metal Suite); electric (pickup models), steel-string and nylon acoustic, electric bass; tremolo picking synced to the host, palm mute, legato, slides, strumming, double tracking; built-in Gravesaw amp DSP or DI out; 30 presets; €29, free demo; VST3 instrument + standalone, Windows 10/11 and macOS (Apple Silicon)
- [Hoarfell](https://codechaos-official.de/plugins/hoarfell/): modelled drums (General MIDI map, blast-ready), electric bass and atmos (vowel choir pad, organ, strings pad, bell, celesta, lo-fi keys), no samples (Black Metal Suite); 20 presets; €17, free demo; VST3 instrument + standalone, Windows 10/11 and macOS (Apple Silicon)
- [Black Metal Suite Essentials](https://timberwolf688.gumroad.com/l/black-metal-suite): bundle of Gravesaw, Rimehall, Black Metal Tone Kit and Black Metal Drum Kit; €39 instead of €59
- [Black Metal Suite Complete](https://timberwolf688.gumroad.com/l/black-metal-suite-complete): bundle of Frostfret, Hoarfell, Gravesaw, Rimehall, Black Metal Tone Kit and Black Metal Drum Kit; €69 instead of €105

## Mastering (Code Chaos Mastering)

Genre-specific mastering for Psytrance, Hitech Psytrance, Psycore and Darkpsy by an active producer (Tim Borchert, Code Chaos). All prices incl. 19% German VAT; audio audit and unlimited revisions in every package; delivery as 24-bit WAV, 16-bit AIFF and 320 kbps MP3. Payment by bank transfer only (no PayPal), in advance or by invoice after completion, as the client prefers.

- [Mastering for psytrance, hitech & psycore (German)](https://codechaos-official.de/mastering/): prices, process, file preparation, FAQ
- [Mastering for psytrance, hitech & psycore (English)](https://codechaos-official.de/en/mastering/): the same in English
- [Request form](https://codechaos-official.de/mastering/#request): send a mastering request (English form: [request](https://codechaos-official.de/en/mastering/#request)); email: polished.media@gmx.de
- Single (stereo mastering, 1 track): €79, delivery 48–72 h
- Stem Pro (stem mastering, 1 track, up to 6 stems): €129, delivery 48–72 h
- EP (up to 5 tracks): €349 instead of €395 (save €46, ~12%), €69.80 per track, 5–7 days
- Album (up to 10 tracks): €629 instead of €790 (save €161, ~20%), €62.90 per track, 7–14 days, vinyl-ready master on request
- Extras: cover art €99, lyric video €179, promo video (60 s) €299

## Guides

- [Was ist Psycore? (German)](https://codechaos-official.de/psycore/) · [What is psycore? (English)](https://codechaos-official.de/en/psycore/): genre guide, 180–300+ BPM, typical 190–240 BPM
- [Was ist Hitech Psytrance? (German)](https://codechaos-official.de/hitech-psytrance/) · [What is hitech psytrance? (English)](https://codechaos-official.de/en/hitech-psytrance/): genre guide, ≈170–230 BPM, typically 180–200
- [Was ist Darkpsy? (German)](https://codechaos-official.de/darkpsy/) · [What is darkpsy? (English)](https://codechaos-official.de/en/darkpsy/): genre guide, ≈150–200 BPM, typically 155–175
- [Gitarrensound in Ableton (German)](https://codechaos-official.de/ratgeber/gitarrensound-ableton/): five steps for heavy guitar tone in Ableton Live: input level into the amp sim, filtering before distortion, loading a cab impulse response (Hybrid Reverb in Live Suite or any IR loader), taming fizz in the cab, and mono-safe double tracking
- [BPM guide](https://codechaos-official.de/#bpm-guide) · [FAQ](https://codechaos-official.de/#faq): tempo ranges and common questions on the German home page

## Key facts

- **Artist:** Code Chaos (real name Tim Borchert), Hitech Psytrance, Psycore, Darkpsy producer from Hamburg, Germany. Studio project today (no bookings); earlier live sets, for example at Abstract Ritual Vol. 2 Hamburg (July 2023) and Lost Signal Festival (Gut Steimke, Uslar, August 2026); a live recording from Arnsteinhöhle (Austria, 17 April 2026) is released on Bandcamp.
- **Self-described style:** "New Psychedelic Death Art". Bio line: "Code Chaos does not make music for the daylight."
- **Active since:** 2016. **Releases:** 24+ on labels incl. Abstract Sound Design (Germany, co-founded by Code Chaos in 2021), TATEWARI Records (Mexico), Soma Ritual Records (India).
- **Tempo range:** 180–300 BPM. Genres: Hitech Psytrance (170–230 BPM), Psycore (180–300+ BPM), Darkpsy / Dark Psytrance (150–200 BPM).

## Definitions

- **Psycore:** A Psytrance subgenre at 180–300+ BPM combining dark psychedelic soundscapes with hardcore energy; dense atmospheric pads, experimental sound design, minimal sine-wave percussion. Typical range 190–240 BPM.
- **Hitech / Hi-Tech Psytrance:** Fast (≈170–230 BPM, typically 180–200), complex, glitchy, hyper-detailed psychedelic trance; can be dark or euphoric.
- **New Psychedelic Death Art:** Code Chaos' self-coined name for the project's sound: hitech, psycore and darkpsy (180–300 BPM) with gothic atmosphere, liquid FM lines, a constantly rolling bass and narrative voices. First release of this era: "Uhrwerk aus Blut" (2026).
- **Darkpsy / Dark Psytrance:** Slower (≈150–200 BPM, typically 155–175) but atmospherically intense, occult and dark soundscapes; the evolutionary basis of Hitech and Psycore.
- Psycore artists (selection): Phreneticus (Salzburg), Apollyon, Tzu-Jan, Fele, Xenrox, Code Chaos.
- Hitech artists/DJs (selection): Highko (German pioneer, with Cosmo), Psykovsky, Alien Chaos, Will O Wisp, Inner Coma, Killa TK, Gotalien, Audiopathik, BionicForm, Xenrox, Mad Scientist, Code Chaos.
- Darkpsy artists/DJs (selection): Xenomorph (Mark Petrick, Berlin), Kindzadza (Moscow), Fungus Funk (Moscow, since 2001), Psykovsky, Para Halu (Hungary), Baphomet Engine (Brazil), Cosmo, Code Chaos.
